about: Pages settling after a published SEO change. While an entry is inside its settle window, scripts/enforcement/page-settle-gate.js fails a release range that edits its sources unless a commit carries a 'Settle-Override: <reason>' trailer. Add an entry in the PR that ships a title, meta, heading or body change meant to move rankings; the gate reads this file at the range base, so the shipping PR is not blocked by its own entry. Remove an entry once its window has passed and the readback is recorded. Verdict tracking (Sawyer, 2026-11-20, agent-issues #80): each entry also carries kind, baseline, verdictDue (rounded up to a Monday; the Monday verdict task judges it), optional finalVerdictDue, and verdict (null until written: keep, keep-no-lift, revert, or replaced). A revert needs evidence of harm, such as the brief's position-loss limit or zero clicks above its impression floor; no lift means keep-no-lift. One verdict per page: a later change on the same route replaces the earlier entry's verdict. A harm verdict on a held guide or new page goes to Sawyer as a proposal. shipped and live are the America/New_York date of the first production publish that contains the change; shipped is the settle-gate switch; leave it null for shared source files and put the live date in live. Fact fixes are in liveChecks, which the gate does not read.
